title: meter ledger row (M0)
description: One line of .dag/runs/<run-id>/meter/ledger.jsonl, and one row of the `ledger` table in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/meter/vault.db. Matches meter-handoff.md Section 6.3's `ledger` table exactly; see meter/store.py's module docstring for the one additive table (`ledger_rounds`, not represented here) this schema doesn't cover.

node.description: DAG-NODE id, e.g. P1-architecture-specialist, T-003-worker; null when correlation failed

agent_id.description: Claude Code's own subagent identifier, or main:<session_id> for the orchestrator's own thread

in_tok.description: null means unmeasured, not zero — see `reason` in the corresponding ledger_rounds row

source.description: vault is reserved for M5; M0 only ever writes live
